bank.about: Your money, kept by Ione. Nothing here costs a tide.
do: Purse: spending coin. It earns nothing and can be stolen.
Vault: savings. Earns a little, can't be stolen.
Leviathan Credit: pay the minimum each season, or lose Standing.

market.about: Food, and pearls that hold their value.
do: Your household eats 20 kelp a season. Cheapest in Summer, dearest in the Long Dark.
Your cellar holds 60. Stored kelp spoils a little each season.
market.cost: First trip each season free, then 1 tide

harbor.about: Buy shares in shipping houses. Buy your Passage.
do: Voyages land each season end: success lifts a house's shares, failure sinks them.
The Tide Index holds every house, so one wreck hurts less.
Shares fall 20% when the Long Dark begins. Sell before then if you need coin.
harbor.cost: First visit each season free, then 1 tide

do: A shift pays your wage and costs a tide.
Six tides a season. When they're gone, the season ends.

drowned_bell.about: Nerissa's tavern: rumors and games of chance.
do: Rumors here are right about 7 times in 10.
Three games a season. Every game pays back less than it takes.

black_reef.about: Grin lends to anyone. That's the trap.
do: Borrow up to 300◈, no Standing needed.
The fee grows by half every season: 100◈ → 150◈ → 225◈.

circle.about: Old Maro's lending circle: neighbours who pool coin and take turns.
do: Take the pot early and repay it a little each season.
Keep every payment and the circle stands by you at the end.

council.about: The Council of Ten rules Atlantis. The Herald never lies.
do: It sets the tithe (40◈ a season) and the Vault's rate.
It can debase the coin: prices jump, your coin doesn't.

maro_questions.q: What do you owe, and to whom? Nobody boards that ship owing.
Your card grows a little every season. What will it cost if you only ever pay the minimum?
If your roof leaked tomorrow, where would the coin come from?
Passage climbs every season. Is your coin climbing faster than the price?
That coin in your Purse: is it working for you, or just waiting to be stolen?
Kelp is dearest in the Long Dark. How full will your cellar be when the dark comes?
You have your Passage. Who else in this city could use a little help?
When the tide turns against you, who would you turn to?

shells.name: Nerissa's Shells
shells.rules: Three shells, one pearl. Pick the shell with the pearl and win back 2.5× your stake.

wheel.name: The Kraken's Wheel
wheel.rules: Spin the wheel. Most spins land on the kraken and take your stake; a few pay double, four times, or ten times.

win: Nerissa slides your winnings across the bar. "Don't spend it all in one tide."
The whole tavern cheers. Nerissa just smiles.
"Luck's on your side tonight," says Nerissa. "It usually changes its mind."
lose: Nerissa sweeps your coin into the till. "The board doesn't lie, love."
The kraken wins again. It usually does.
"Every game pays back less than it takes," Nerissa reminds you, not unkindly.
tavern.limit: Nerissa wipes down the table. "That's enough games for one season."
